# Nihar Ranjan Rout | Creuto

> Nihar Ranjan Rout is the Founder and CEO of Creuto, a founder-led product and engineering company based in Bhubaneswar, India. He has 8+ years in product management and has led 50+ products: mobile apps, web apps, custom software and ERP, and AI products. Work is done by an in-house team, starts with a PRD and a clickable prototype, and uses fixed milestones. Client code lives in the client's own accounts from day one. Creuto is an OpenAI Select Partner and has a 5.0 rating from 16 verified Clutch reviews.

- [UPI Payment Integration for Apps and Websites: A Guide](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/upi-payment-integration-for-apps): How UPI payment integration works in apps and websites: intent, collect and QR flows, payment gateways, autopay, refunds and the cases you must test.

- [What Is a PRD? How to Write a Product Requirements Document](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/what-is-a-prd-how-to-write-a-product-requirements-document): A PRD (product requirements document) turns an idea into something a team can build. Learn the 10 sections, PRD vs BRD, and common mistakes.
- [WhatsApp Business API: A Practical Guide for Businesses](https://www.niharrout.com/blog/whatsapp-business-api-guide): What the WhatsApp Business API (WhatsApp Business Platform) is, how it differs from the app, templates, opt-in, CRM integration and chatbot use cases.
